verdict.rationale: The 01 is an agent that executes code, browses the web, manages files and controls third-party software, so enforced scoping of apps, surfaces or accounts is a fair question for it. The only related evidence is editing profiles to customize behavior and the system message. That is an adjacent, advisory configuration, not a documented enforced allowlist or permission boundary. No evidence shows the agent can be technically restricted to specific apps or accounts.
